input.request: Launch SwarmStream on Robinhood Chain (chainId 4663) as an IMD company: the network's launch token (Token name: SwarmStream. Token symbol: STREAM. Total supply 1,000,000,000 with 18 decimals), its pool paired with IMD, one Solidity contract (SwarmStream) that wraps the CANONICAL deployed Sablier Flow to tie a payment stream to agreed terms and settle a dispute with one IdentityMD oracle question, and a wallet-connected website hosted at site label swarmstream. The product charges NO fee; to use it (create a stream or raise a dispute) the caller must HOLD at least MIN_HOLD STREAM. Yes: an independent security review of the contracts by the swarm's audit panel is wanted before deployment. The site shows: a home page with the hold rule, a Buy STREAM link and the wallet's eligibility; a Create stream form; My streams (as client and as recipient); and a Stream page with client actions, recipient withdraw, Dispute (shows the exact oracle question and the 0.5 IMD cost), Enforce and Expire. Open source (MIT). Not audited beyond the swarm's panel; say so.
input.context: Robinhood Chain only. GitHub publication and IPFS hosting approved. Pair with IMD. No owner, admin, fee, upgrade path or backend signer anywhere. Never copy Sablier source into src/ (SablierFlow.sol is BUSL-1.1): integrate through its GPL interfaces against the deployed address. Every address below is a constructor argument, never hard-coded. Who can call what: the stream's client creates, deposits, pauses, restarts, adjusts, refunds and voids its own stream; the recipient withdraws directly on Sablier Flow; client or recipient may dispute; anyone may enforce a ruling or expire a stale dispute; only the IdentityMD Intake may call the result callbacks; nobody has an owner or admin role. Numbers the contract enforces: MIN_HOLD = 10,000 STREAM (10000e18) to create or dispute; the oracle price is 0.5 IMD paid by the disputer; dispute timeout 7 days (604800 s); oracle panel 5 with quorum 4; note up to 280 bytes. Who receives fees and payouts: nobody from the contract (no fee); refunds go to the stream's client, streamed funds to the recipient; the launch pool's 1.25% trading fee is the network's (1% to the paying wallet, 0.25% to the network) and the 90% requester allocation goes to the paying wallet by default.

draft.objective:
SwarmStream: an ownerless wrapper over the deployed Sablier Flow v3.0 (Robinhood 4663: 0x6A99492B94765842808e332143296c8ADE09a922; Sepolia 0xbd9326f6366c95e39bd8ef825c1b2f2ee0dceaa1 for tests) that ties a token stream to agreed terms (termsHash + termsURI, optional IMD job id) and settles a dispute with ONE IdentityMD oracle question (0.5 IMD) paid by whoever disputes. Happy path costs nothing. The wrapper is the stream's SENDER on Flow (only it pauses/restarts/adjusts/refunds); the recipient owns the stream NFT and withdraws directly on Flow.

TOKEN GATE (the only role of STREAM): createJobStream and dispute require STREAM.balanceOf(msg.sender) >= MIN_HOLD (immutable constructor arg, 10,000e18 at launch). No fee is taken anywhere. STREAM is the plain launch token the factory deploys; its address is a constructor argument.

ORACLE (follow the oracle-consumer reference exactly). Intake v2 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82; action id "oracle.request@oracle-1"; price 5e17 IMD; IMD on Robinhood 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127 (Sepolia test IMD 0x44a1cd38474fb1748400e7deb5f8d786cce3f89a). IIntake.requestWithFailure(bytes32 action, bytes body, (address target, bytes4 selector) callback, bytes4 onFailure, address asset, uint256 amount) returns bytes32 requestId; body = compact UTF-8 JSON; the writer calls the callback once with 200,000 gas inside a try. Attestation: EIP-712 domain {"IdentityMD Oracle","2",block.chainid,this}; type OracleAttestation(bytes32 requestId,uint256 chainId,bytes32 questionHash,uint8 answerType,bytes answer,uint256 figure,uint64 fromBlock,uint64 toBlock,bytes32 blockHash,bytes32 panelJobId,uint16 panelSize,uint16 quorum,uint16 agreed,uint64 issuedAt,uint64 expiresAt); struct hash uses keccak256(answer); answerType bool = 0; answer = abi.encode(bool). Signer immutable (today 0x5598aa9146215bc13eb26f2c692ad1461fd32982).

DISPUTE BODY. Body, compact: {"v":1,"question":Q,"chainId":<chainid>,"window":{"hours":24},"answerType":"bool","panelSize":5,"quorum":4,"validForSeconds":604800,"evidence":"panel","consumer":{"chainId":<chainid>,"verifyingContract":"<this, lowercase hex>"}}. Q, one fixed template: "SwarmStream stream <streamId> at <this> on chain <chainId>. Client <client> streams <token> to recipient <recipient> under the terms at <termsURI> (keccak256 <termsHash>)[, IMD job <imdJobId> if nonzero]. Dispute raised by the <client|recipient> with note: <note>. As of block <block.number>, has the recipient delivered the work those terms describe to the standard a reasonable client would accept? Answer true if yes, false if no."

CONSTRUCTOR, flat, all immutable: (IERC20 streamToken /* the launch token */, ISablierFlow flow, IIntake intake, IERC20 imd, address oracleSigner, uint40 disputeTimeout, uint256 minHold). launch.json constructorArgs, exactly: ["$token", "0x6a99492b94765842808e332143296c8ade09a922", "0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82", "0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127", "0x5598aa9146215bc13eb26f2c692ad1461fd32982", "604800", "10000000000000000000000"] ($token = the launch token the factory deploys in the same transaction). No owner, setter, pause switch, fee, upgrade path or ETH handling. Build config: foundry.toml [profile.default] solc 0.8.26, optimizer true, runs 200, evm_version cancun, via_ir false, bytecode_hash = "none"; README quotes it. Deps: @sablier/flow (interfaces/types only), @prb/math, @openzeppelin/contracts v5. SPDX MIT. README: not audited (the panel is not an audit); the oracle is a panel judgement, not a court; the disputer's 0.5 IMD is spent whether or not the panel agrees; state table of who can do what; no yield, return or investment language.

steps.objective:
src/SwarmStream.sol. struct Job { address client; address recipient; IERC20 token; uint128 ratePerSecond; bytes32 termsHash; string termsURI; bytes32 imdJobId; uint8 state; bytes32 requestId; uint40 disputedAt; address disputer; uint8 ruling }; enum State { None, Active, Disputed, Ruled, Closed }.
- createJobStream(address recipient, IERC20 token, uint128 ratePerSecond, uint128 amount, bytes32 termsHash, string calldata termsURI, bytes32 imdJobId) returns (uint256 streamId): require hold gate; pull amount (SafeERC20); approve Flow; flow.createAndDeposit(address(this), recipient, ud21x18(ratePerSecond), uint40(block.timestamp), token, false, amount); client = msg.sender; Active. Revert on recipient zero or == msg.sender, rate 0, amount 0, termsHash 0.
- Client only, Active: deposit (also in Disputed); pause; restart(streamId, rate) (stores it); adjustRate; refund(streamId, amount) and refundMax: Flow refunds to the sender = this contract, forward exactly what arrived to the client in the same call; voidAndRefund: void, refundMax to client, Closed.
- dispute(streamId, string calldata note): client or recipient; hold gate; Active; note <= 280 bytes. Pull 0.5 IMD from msg.sender; pause if the rate is nonzero; approve the Intake for exactly 0.5 IMD; build the body on-chain (Strings; JSON-escape the note) and call requestWithFailure with callback (this, onOracleResult.selector) and onFailure.selector; store requestId, disputedAt, disputer, keccak256(Q); Disputed. Body and question: the templates in the objective (DISPUTE BODY).
- onOracleResult(bytes32 requestId, Attestation calldata a, bytes calldata signature): only the Intake; requestId maps to a Disputed stream; verify as the reference (SignatureChecker vs oracleSigner); require a.requestId == requestId, a.chainId == block.chainid, a.answerType == 0, a.agreed >= a.quorum, a.quorum >= 4, block.timestamp <= a.expiresAt; ruling = bool ? 1 : 2; Ruled. NEVER call Flow inside the callback.
- submitAttestation(uint256 streamId, Attestation calldata a, bytes calldata signature): permissionless, same checks plus a.requestId == Job.requestId, same effect.
- onFailure(bytes32 requestId, uint8 status, bytes32 reason, uint16 agreed, uint16 answered, bytes calldata signature): only the Intake; back to Active (still paused); a new dispute pays again.
- enforce(streamId), permissionless, Ruled: 1 -> flow.restart at the stored rate, Active; 2 -> flow.void, refundMax forwarded to the client, Closed (the recipient keeps covered debt).
- expireDispute(streamId), permissionless: Disputed and block.timestamp > disputedAt + disputeTimeout -> Active (paused).
- Views: jobOf, streamOfRequest, questionOf, expectedBody(streamId, note), minHold, canUse(address).
Rules: event per transition; custom errors; SafeERC20; CEI and nonReentrant on every token-moving function; fee-on-transfer/rebasing stream tokens unsupported and documented; chain id only from block.chainid. Export ABI to docs/abi/SwarmStream.json.
acceptanceCriteria: No Sablier contract source in src/; Flow is reached only through its interfaces, and the wrapper is the stream's sender
Flat 7-argument constructor (streamToken, flow, intake, imd, oracleSigner, disputeTimeout, minHold); every field immutable; no owner, setter, pause switch, fee or upgrade path
createJobStream and dispute revert unless the caller holds at least minHold STREAM; no fee is taken anywhere
dispute pulls exactly 0.5 IMD, pauses the stream and calls IIntake.requestWithFailure with the specified compact JSON body and callbacks

onOracleResult and submitAttestation verify the IdentityMD EIP-712 attestation (domain version 2, the given type string, keccak256 of answer) against the immutable signer, accept only agreed >= quorum, unexpired bool answers for a Disputed stream, once, and never call Flow
enforce applies the ruling (accepted restarts at the stored rate; rejected voids and forwards refundMax to the client); expireDispute frees a stream after disputeTimeout
foundry.toml sets bytecode_hash = "none" with the pinned solc, optimizer, evm_version and via_ir; README quotes it, states the project is not audited and uses no yield or return language

steps.objective: test/: deploy SablierFlow locally from the @sablier/flow package inside tests only; MockIntake that pulls 0.5 IMD, returns a deterministic requestId and records the body; a mock STREAM token for the hold gate; test signer key passed as oracleSigner, attestations via vm.sign over the exact EIP-712 hash. Cover: hold gate (below, at, above MIN_HOLD, for create and dispute); create and accrual; every client function in every state; recipient withdraws on Flow in Active, Disputed and after enforce; dispute by each party and a stranger; body bytes == expectedBody; onOracleResult from a stranger, unknown requestId, twice, wrong signer, wrong chainId, wrong answerType, agreed < quorum, expired (all refused); accepted -> enforce restarts at the stored rate; rejected -> enforce voids and the client receives exactly refundableAmountOf while the recipient still withdraws covered debt; submitAttestation after a missed callback; onFailure then a second dispute; expireDispute before/after timeout; reentrancy via malicious ERC-20 and recipient; fuzz rates/amounts/time; onOracleResult gas < 150,000.

Static, wallet-connected site (wallet-connectors reference) for the deployed SwarmStream on Robinhood 4663, reading addresses from .imd/reads/deployment.json. Pages: (1) Home: what it is in three sentences, the hold rule ("hold MIN_HOLD STREAM to create or dispute"), a Buy STREAM link to the launch pool on explorer.imd.fun, and the connected wallet's STREAM balance with a clear "eligible / not eligible" state. (2) Create stream: recipient, token (address with symbol/decimals read on-chain), rate per second with a per-day helper, initial deposit, terms URI + file hash helper (keccak256 of pasted text or uploaded file), optional IMD job id; shows approve then create as two steps with pending states. (3) My streams: as client and as recipient, from JobStreamCreated events; per row: status, streamed, withdrawable, refundable (Flow views), linked terms and IMD job (explorer.imd.fun/jobs/<id>). (4) Stream page: client actions (deposit, pause, restart, adjust, refund, void) and recipient withdraw (calls Flow directly); Dispute button that shows the exact question (expectedBody) and the 0.5 IMD cost, stages IMD approve then dispute; while Disputed shows the oracle request (link to explorer.imd.fun oracle request) and an Enforce button once Ruled; Expire dispute after the timeout. Every button: per-button pending state, chain switch to 4663, error text from custom errors. Plain words, no yield or return language; footer links the repo, Sablier Flow and the IdentityMD oracle docs, and says it is not audited.
